lines.t: I knew all that you ever said
I thought
I thought that we were chosen
We set our lamps upon our sills
Thinking you knew all our names
Thought to get oil in time to fill
We said that we would be the first
And nobody knew the promised day
When the heavens opened up
Blessed hope just blew away
We dwell where crosses stood as proof
We learned to bless and gilded hall
We spoke our creeds like tidy robes
We wore them when the trumpet had called
We thought you said we were beloved set apart
We thought you said the promise held within the heart
We thought you said we'd stand as bride before the dawn
We thought and yet we are left here
And you are gone
For all pastors, huff and make excuse
Was it just blind leading the blind?
We work wonders in your name
We cast out demons of the night
The town is ash, the lamps are dry
Nurseries echo with our steps
Peace and mercy is our prayer
Silence answers with its death
Where is the scale you would hold
To measure true what stands or bends?
Where is the voice that called us home when in eyes blank the bride was cleansed?
We thought you said we were beloved, set apart
We thought you said the promise held within the heart
We thought you said we'd stand as bride before the dawn
We thought, and yet we are left here
And you are gone
I thought my hands were unblemished
I thought our works would prove my worth
I tasted gift and called it grace
Was plunge in water and called it birth
Did I mistake the gilding for your fruit?
And trade your rains for bottled water
As old as true
I feel crushed
An endless ache
I'm stunned in silence
I cannot face
You took the bright
The sky went mute
I'm left plundered
Holding bitter truths
I thought you said we were beloved, set apart
I thought you said the promise held within the heart
I thought you said we'd stand as bride before the dawn
I thought, and yet we are left here
And you are gone
Yet we are left here
Oh, when we were wrong
I thought that you
I thought that you were near
I can never be mistaken
I thought
